findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_resolution_options · Private data: estimate_irs_penalty, explain_tax_document, deadline_calendar, get_document_checklist, check_itin_eligibility, check_5472_obligation · Public sink: get_document_checklist · Destructive: triage_tax_problem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_resolution_options · Private data: estimate_irs_penalty, explain_tax_document, deadline_calendar, get_document_checklist, check_itin_eligibility, check_5472_obligation · Public sink: get_document_checklist · Destructive: triage_tax_problem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
